content.text: {"pagination":{"count":10,"page":1,"next_page":2,"total_count":1000,"total_pages":100},"records":[{"platform":"desktop","title":"Craft Docs","url":"https://craft.do","uuid":"285cc0ca-d47b-495d-9e49-c4326c5cd7ea","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/craft.do/285cc0ca-d47b-495d-9e49-c4326c5cd7ea/preview_0.jpg","description":"A warm, scrapbook-inspired digital product landing page with a tactile, handcrafted feel. The visual language combines a soft off-white canvas with airy pastel accents like mint, marigold, sky blue, and periwinkle, creating a gentle and inviting mood. Large serif headlines dominate the composition with a refined, editorial presence and tight letter spacing, while clean sans-serif text keeps navigation, labels, and supporting copy crisp and functional. The layout is spacious and centered, with generous vertical breathing room and calm, balanced sections rather than dense or busy arrangements. Rounded cards, pill buttons, and floating panels soften the interface, while multi-layered shadows give elements a lightly lifted, paper-cutout quality. Decorative torn-paper edges, collage-like color blocks, grid textures, and layered image frames reinforce the analog scrapbook aesthetic, making the whole experience feel creative, polished, and thoughtfully crafted. Imagery is integrated like mounted clippings or mockup inserts, with subtle framing and soft depth that blend digital precision with a handmade journal look."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Symbolic.ai","url":"https://symbolic.ai","uuid":"b49ec76c-1410-44cb-9de1-b5ac58255949","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/symbolic.ai/b49ec76c-1410-44cb-9de1-b5ac58255949/preview_0.jpg","description":"A calm, editorial AI landing-page aesthetic with a paper-white canvas, warm ivory undertones, and crisp black typography. The composition feels airy and restrained, with a centered hero, generous whitespace, and a very light top navigation bar that blends into the page rather than framing it. The headline uses a refined serif display style that gives the interface a magazine-like, high-trust tone, while the supporting copy is small, precise, and understated. Buttons are compact, pill-shaped, and filled in black, creating a strong but quiet contrast against the pale background. The most distinctive visual motif is the layered paper-card treatment: overlapping document-like panels, soft shadows, slight rotations, and organic edges that make the interface feel tactile, like printed sheets arranged on a desk. Accent color is used sparingly, mostly as a subtle violet loading state and occasional muted highlights, keeping the palette mostly monochrome and parchment-toned. Overall it feels minimalist, premium, and thoughtful—part product demo, part modern editorial system, with a handcrafted analog texture wrapped around a clean SaaS structure."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"mymind","url":"https://mymind.com","uuid":"3473a05f-d9c9-4b61-ba93-6c5569afb103","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/mymind.com/3473a05f-d9c9-4b61-ba93-6c5569afb103/preview_0.jpg","description":"A sunlit, editorial-style productivity landing page with a very soft, airy atmosphere and a warm, private-archive feel. The visual signature is the oversized Louize serif headline, set in dramatic black with tight negative tracking, paired with small rounded UI labels in a clean sans-serif and generous letter spacing. The hero is built around a large coral-to-white radial bloom that feels like natural afternoon light rather than a graphic background, giving the whole page a serene, glowing warmth. The layout is spacious and centered, with a restrained top navigation, minimal orange dot accents, and pill-shaped outline buttons that feel inviting rather than forceful. Content is presented as isolated artifacts inside browser-like frames and pastel-tinted cards in slate blue, parchment, and sage, creating a gentle scrapbook mood without relying on shadows. Overall it feels refined, calm, and slightly luxurious — part editorial magazine, part curated personal archive, with strong typography, soft color layering, and a deliberately unhurried rhythm."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Chester's Garden","url":"https://chester.how","uuid":"c1332952-efd0-48cc-826a-ecb0778f04e2","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/chester.how/c1332952-efd0-48cc-826a-ecb0778f04e2/preview_0.jpg","description":"A light, airy digital garden journal with the feeling of a curated personal notebook. The interface is built on a warm off-white canvas with soft gray dividers and lots of breathing room, giving everything a crisp paper-like quality. Typography is the star: large, elegant serif headlines create a literary, reflective mood, while clean sans-serif body text keeps the layout grounded and readable. The overall hierarchy feels editorial and intimate rather than corporate, with content presented like handwritten notes, reading lists, and personal observations.\n\nThe layout mixes a calm introductory text block with a more dynamic masonry-style grid of cards, creating a rhythm that feels collected over time. Cards are softly rounded, lightly bordered, and subtly lifted with gentle shadows, like printed clippings placed on a desk. Imagery is varied and personal—photography, book covers, UI mockups, textures, and abstract graphics—making the page feel lived-in and visually scrapbook-like. Color is used sparingly but purposefully in small pill tags and labels, where muted oranges, violets, blues, and greens act like index tabs or sticky notes. Buttons and tabs are minimal and pill-shaped, reinforcing the notebook-organizer aesthetic. Overall, the design feels polished, thoughtful, and quietly expressive, with a refined balance between structure and organic curation."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Superr","url":"https://www.superr.ai","uuid":"b569caf4-4fcf-48b4-9440-d2a99a9ffe9a","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/www.superr.ai/b569caf4-4fcf-48b4-9440-d2a99a9ffe9a/preview_0.jpg","description":"A warm, whimsical, childlike product-landing aesthetic with the feel of a beloved sketchbook brought to life. The visual tone is airy and hand-crafted, built on a soft off-white parchment canvas with lots of open space and gentle asymmetry. Typography is the defining character: oversized, rounded, handwritten-style display type for headlines that feels playful and a little uneven, paired with clean, readable sans-serif supporting text. The hierarchy is simple and text-forward, with short copy blocks and a few small, emphatic accent words in bright, primary-school colors. Interactive elements are minimal and charming, especially the pill-shaped outline CTA and tiny ghost-like links that read like doodled annotations rather than formal controls. Imagery carries most of the personality: large cropped 3D notebook renders, angled product shots, pencil props, and floating sticker illustrations create a tactile, scrapbook-like collage. Borders and shadows are subtle, with soft elevation and rounded corners that keep everything friendly and light. Overall it feels handmade, youthful, cheerful, and delightfully imperfect, like a premium children’s notebook brand with a playful creative-tech spirit."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"DrawHistory","url":"https://drawhistory.com","uuid":"95233b5f-e75b-4ac5-892e-e94927d34311","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/drawhistory.com/95233b5f-e75b-4ac5-892e-e94927d34311/preview_0.jpg","description":"A warm, editorial agency landing screen with a restrained manifesto feel and a dark, atmospheric backdrop. The composition is centered and contained, with two large chunky cards set side by side, each with generous padding, soft rounded corners, and a strong sense of weight. Typography is the main visual anchor: tall, elegant serif headings in all caps with tight leading, paired with smaller calm body copy that reads like an announcement or open letter. The palette mixes muted earth tones and charcoal surfaces with a subtle parchment-like lightness in the lighter states, while a tiny orange accent at the top adds just enough heat and urgency. Buttons are understated and text-forward, outlined or minimally filled, reinforcing the quiet confidence of the layout. Imagery is tightly cropped and editorial, presented as a framed photo and a logo tile rather than decorative art, which gives the design a curated, commemorative tone. Overall it feels polished, grounded, and intentionally spare — like a thoughtful brand transition announcement designed with tactile surfaces, clear hierarchy, and a premium print-inspired sensibility."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Nathan Riley","url":"https://www.nrly.co","uuid":"41b626a3-496c-41ee-9c04-c60f471379d4","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/www.nrly.co/41b626a3-496c-41ee-9c04-c60f471379d4/preview_0.jpg","description":"A serene, editorial portfolio aesthetic with a soft dreamlike mood and a strong gallery-first layout. The interface feels immersive and art-led, with a dense mosaic of square imagery flowing edge to edge in a tight grid, almost like a curated exhibition wall. Pastel pink accents appear sparingly and feel intentional, balancing the otherwise muted palette of black, white, charcoal, and soft neutrals. Typography is elegant and expressive: large serif display lettering creates a sophisticated, fashion-forward presence, while small sans-serif text keeps the supporting copy crisp and functional. The overall hierarchy is minimal and refined, letting the imagery dominate while navigation and controls stay quiet and understated. Buttons are simple pill shapes with thin outlines, and section cards use flat surfaces with little to no ornamental depth. Spacing feels measured and balanced, giving the composition a calm rhythm despite the visual density. The result is polished, contemporary, and contemplative, with a tactile, atmospheric quality that suits an artistic design portfolio."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Paper","url":"https://paper.design","uuid":"948949c4-65e1-4f9a-a1ca-d4eadc2e3014","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/paper.design/948949c4-65e1-4f9a-a1ca-d4eadc2e3014/preview_0.jpg","description":"A light, architectural product-marketing aesthetic with a warm parchment base, airy spacing, and a highly structured editorial feel. The interface uses off-white and beige surfaces layered with faint blueprint-like grid and paper textures, giving it a calm, engineered, almost drafting-table character. Typography is the main visual voice: large Matter-style headlines in soft charcoal and muted grey create a refined, understated hierarchy, while smaller Inter text keeps the layout precise and utilitarian. The top navigation is slim and quiet, with simple text links and a restrained brand mark, reinforcing the sense of a focused design tool rather than a flashy consumer product. Buttons are compact and pragmatic, with a solid black primary CTA that stands out cleanly against the pale background and a text-like secondary action beside it. Large overlapping product screenshots act as the hero imagery, framed like floating panels with minimal-radius corners and subtle elevation, adding density and realism without visual noise. The overall composition feels connected, technical, and premium, balancing monochrome discipline with just a small amount of soft blue accenting for interactive emphasis. It reads as a polished design-tool or creative-workspace landing screen: precise, calm, and deliberately crafted."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Cori Corinne","url":"https://www.coricorinne.com","uuid":"08b879e1-2871-488f-b573-38e438e9a85c","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/www.coricorinne.com/08b879e1-2871-488f-b573-38e438e9a85c/preview_0.jpg","description":"A refined editorial portfolio aesthetic with a warm parchment background, crisp black text, and very large high-contrast serif display typography. The composition feels spacious, gallery-like, and intentionally restrained, with minimal chrome and a strong focus on scale: a tiny top navigation in clean sans serif sits above an oversized hero title that dominates the screen. The palette is almost entirely neutral, leaning into soft off-white, deep charcoal, and pure black, which gives the interface a quiet luxury and print-inspired mood. Visual texture comes from grainy, high-contrast photography used as large atmospheric blocks beneath the headline, adding a tactile, art-directed feel without introducing color noise. Spacing is generous and airy, with full-bleed sections and clean structural alignment that keep the layout elegant and uncluttered. Interaction elements appear understated and text-based, with a classic, editorial confidence rather than a digital-product feel. Overall it reads like a sophisticated design studio or fashion-editorial landing experience: minimal, poetic, typographically led, and carefully composed."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Operate","url":"https://operate.so","uuid":"a0f473eb-0310-4df5-b5f6-5bc124ad5954","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/operate.so/a0f473eb-0310-4df5-b5f6-5bc124ad5954/preview_0.jpg","description":"A highly structured, ledger-like SaaS landing page with a quiet artisanal feel. The screen is dominated by a pale cool-green canvas with a faint grid and fine ruled lines, giving it the look of a technical chart or archived record sheet. The hero visual is the main event: a dense, abstract data landscape made from scattered outlined circles, a flowing blue waveform band, and a trail of light markers, all floating inside the grid with an almost hand-plotted quality. Typography is compact and understated, with small meta labels and restrained navigation tucked into the edges, reinforcing the precise, document-like hierarchy. The palette stays tightly controlled: soft mint and sage surfaces, muted neutrals, deep green text accents, and a single violet button used as a surprising focal point. Borders are thin and inset, shadows are minimal, and surfaces feel flat yet tactile, like printed matter translated into a modern digital system. Overall it feels meticulous, calm, data-driven, and slightly experimental, with a strong emphasis on spacing, alignment, and visual rhythm rather than glossy polish."}]}
